title: Next.js Small Examples
description: Use these small Next.js examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Make the home page
examples.description: A page.tsx file defines what a route shows.
examples.code:
// app/page.tsx export default function Home(){return

Reading club

Pick a story today.

;}
examples.output: The home address shows the Reading club heading and paragraph.

examples.title: Add a second route
examples.description: A folder with its own page.tsx makes a route.
examples.code:
// app/books/page.tsx export default function Books(){return

Books

  • Moon Trip
;}

examples.title: Move between pages with Link
examples.description: Next.js Link makes navigation between local routes.
examples.output: The link moves to the existing /books route.

examples.title: Share a root layout
examples.description: A layout wraps pages that belong under it.
examples.output: The header and footer surround each page placed inside this root layout.

examples.title: Add page metadata
examples.description: Metadata gives a page a browser title and search description.
examples.output: The browser tab uses Books | Reading Club. The page includes the description metadata.

examples.title: Create a browser counter
examples.description: A Client Component can use browser state and click handlers.
examples.output: When imported and rendered by a page, the counter updates after clicks in the browser.

examples.title: Pass data to a client part
examples.description: A server page can pass simple serialisable values into a Client Component.
examples.output: The button shows Mia and uses that string when clicked.

examples.title: Use a local public file
examples.description: Files in public are served from the site root.
examples.output: The page loads the actual local club.svg file and reserves its image space.

examples.title: Keep component styles local
examples.description: A CSS module gives a component named classes that are scoped by the build.
examples.output: After saving the actual CSS rule in Card.module.css, the card gets a border and padding.

examples.title: Generate a small set of book pages
examples.description: A dynamic route folder uses a value from the address.
examples.output: The build can create pages for moon-trip and garden-days. Their titles show the matching slug.

examples.title: Show a helpful missing-page message
examples.description: A not-found file supplies a useful message when the app reaches a missing page.
examples.output: The app has a clear missing-page view with a working local route link.

examples.title: Export static site files
examples.description: A static export builds files that a static host can serve.
examples.output: The out folder contains deployable static files for the supported routes.
